name: inspect_object
title: Inspect a Waterloo object
description: Inspect one Waterloo object together with its signature, examples, and reverse references.

arguments.name: root_id
arguments.description: The root identifier that contains the object.

messages.content:
Inspect the Waterloo object $qid in root $root_id.

Start with `get_object`.
Then inspect `get_signature`, `get_examples`, `get_references`, and `search_related`.
Use `get_section` or `get_subsection` only when you need a specific detail.

Summarize:
- the object's signature
- its normative sections
- its examples
- its direct links to related objects
